auth.description: To get your PDF.co API key please [click here to create your account](https://app.pdf.co/).

add_barcode_to_pdf.name: add_barcode_to_pdf
add_barcode_to_pdf.description: Generate a barcode image and add it to a specific location on a PDF.

sourcePdfUrl.description: URL of the PDF file to add the barcode to.

barcodeValue.description: The text or data to encode in the barcode.

barcodeType.description: Select the type of barcode to generate.

x.description: X coordinate (from top-left corner) to place the barcode.

y.description: Y coordinate (from top-left corner) to place the barcode.

width.description: Optional width for the barcode image on the PDF (in points). Aspect ratio is kept by default.

height.description: Optional height for the barcode image on the PDF (in points). Aspect ratio is kept by default.

pages.description: Comma-separated page numbers or ranges to add the barcode (e.g., "0,2,5-10"). Leave empty for all pages.

fileName.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

expiration.description: Set the expiration time for the output link in minutes (default is 60 i.e 60 minutes or 1 hour).

pdfPassword.description: Password if the source PDF is protected.

httpUsername.description: HTTP auth username if required to access source url.

httpPassword.description: HTTP auth password if required to access source url.

aiMetadata.description: Generates a barcode (QR, DataMatrix, Code 128/39, PDF417, EAN-13, or UPC-A) and stamps it onto a source PDF (referenced by URL) at the given x/y coordinates. Use when an agent needs to embed a scannable code into an existing document. Each call produces a new output PDF file and consumes credits, so it is not idempotent.

add_image_to_pdf.name: add_image_to_pdf
add_image_to_pdf.description: Add image to a PDF document.

url.description: URL of the PDF file to modify.

xCoordinate.description: X coordinate (from top-left corner) to place the image.

yCoordinate.description: Y coordinate (from top-left corner) to place the image.

width.description: Optional width for the image on the PDF (in points). Aspect ratio is kept by default.

height.description: Optional height for the image on the PDF (in points). Aspect ratio is kept by default.

pages.description: Specify page indices as comma-separated values or ranges to process (e.g. "0, 1, 2-" or "1, 2, 3-7").

fileName.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

expiration.description: Set the expiration time for the output link in minutes (default is 60 i.e 60 minutes or 1 hour).

pdfPassword.description: Password if the source PDF is protected.

httpUsername.description: HTTP auth username if required to access source url.

httpPassword.description: HTTP auth password if required to access source url.

aiMetadata.description: Overlays an image (referenced by URL) onto a source PDF (referenced by URL) at the given x/y coordinates, optionally on specific pages. Use when an agent needs to stamp a logo, signature, or other graphic onto an existing document. Each call produces a new output PDF file and consumes credits, so it is not idempotent.

url.description: URL of the PDF file to modify.

pages.description: Specify page indices as comma-separated values or ranges to process (e.g. "0, 1, 2-" or "1, 2, 3-7").

fileName.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

expiration.description: Set the expiration time for the output link in minutes (default is 60 i.e 60 minutes or 1 hour).

pdfPassword.description: Password if the source PDF is protected.

httpUsername.description: HTTP auth username if required to access source url.

httpPassword.description: HTTP auth password if required to access source url.

aiMetadata.description: Stamps a text annotation onto a source PDF (referenced by URL) at the given x/y coordinates, with optional font, size, color, and styling. Use when an agent needs to write text onto an existing document. Each call produces a new output PDF file and consumes credits, so it is not idempotent.

convert_html_to_pdf.name: convert_html_to_pdf
convert_html_to_pdf.description: Convert HTML code into a downloadable PDF document.

html.description: The HTML code to convert to PDF.

name.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

margins.description: CSS style margins (e.g., "10px", "5mm 5mm 5mm 5mm" for top, right, bottom, left).

paperSize.description: Select a paper size. For custom sizes, input the value directly (e.g., '200mm 300mm') if your desired size isn't listed. Refer to PDF.co docs.

options.placeholder: Select paper size or input custom

printBackground.description: Set to true to print background graphics and colors (default is true).

header.description: HTML content for the page header.

footer.description: HTML content for the page footer.

doNotWaitFullLoad.displayName: Do not wait till full page load ?

expiration.description: Set the expiration time for the output link in minutes (default is 60).

aiMetadata.description: Renders a block of HTML into a new PDF document, with optional paper size, orientation, margins, header/footer, and media-type controls. Use when an agent needs to turn HTML markup into a downloadable PDF. Each call generates a new output file and consumes credits, so it is not idempotent.

convert_pdf_to_structured_format.name: convert_pdf_to_structured_format
convert_pdf_to_structured_format.description: Convert PDF content into structured formats (JSON, CSV, or XML).

url.description: URL of the PDF file to convert.

outputFormat.description: Select the desired structured output format.

pages.description: Comma-separated page numbers or ranges (e.g., "0,2,5-10"). Leave empty for all pages.

lang.description: Language for OCR if processing scanned documents (e.g., "eng", "deu", "eng+deu"). See PDF.co docs for list.

fileName.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

expiration.description: Set the expiration time for the output link in minutes (default is 60 i.e 60 minutes or 1 hour).

pdfPassword.description: Password if the source PDF is protected.

httpUsername.description: HTTP auth username if required to access source url.

httpPassword.description: HTTP auth password if required to access source url.

aiMetadata.description: Converts a source PDF (referenced by URL) into structured data, with the output format selectable between JSON, CSV, or XML. Optional OCR language handles scanned documents. Use when an agent needs machine-readable data extracted from a PDF. Each call generates a new output file and consumes credits, so it is not idempotent.

extract_tables_from_pdf.name: extract_tables_from_pdf
extract_tables_from_pdf.description: Extracts table data from a PDF using a predefined PDF.co Document Parser template.

url.description: URL of the PDF file to extract tables from.

templateId.description: The ID of your Document Parser template (created in PDF.co dashboard) designed to extract the table(s).

pages.description: Comma-separated page numbers or ranges (e.g., "0,2,5-10"). Overrides template settings if provided.

fileName.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

expiration.description: Set the expiration time for the output link in minutes (default is 60 i.e 60 minutes or 1 hour).

pdfPassword.description: Password if the source PDF is protected.

httpUsername.description: HTTP auth username if required to access source url.

httpPassword.description: HTTP auth password if required to access source url.

aiMetadata.description: Extracts table data from a source PDF (referenced by URL) using a predefined PDF.co Document Parser template; requires a Template ID created beforehand in the PDF.co dashboard. Use when an agent needs structured tables from a document whose layout a template already describes. The call only reads the input and returns the parsed tables, so it is idempotent.

extract_text_from_pdf.name: extract_text_from_pdf
extract_text_from_pdf.description: Extracts plain text content from a PDF document.

url.description: URL of the PDF file to extract text from.

pages.description: Comma-separated page numbers or ranges (e.g., "0,2,5-10"). Leave empty for all pages.

password.description: Password if the source PDF is protected.

outputName.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

httpUsername.description: HTTP auth username if required to access source url.

httpPassword.description: HTTP auth password if required to access source url.

aiMetadata.description: Extracts plain text content from a source PDF (referenced by URL), optionally limited to specific pages. Use when an agent needs the raw text of a document for reading or downstream processing. The call only reads the input and returns the text directly, so it is idempotent.

search_and_replace_text.name: search_and_replace_text
search_and_replace_text.displayName: Search and Replace Text in PDF
search_and_replace_text.description: Search for specific text or patterns in a PDF and replace it with new text.

url.description: URL to the source PDF file.

caseSensitive.description: Set to true for case-sensitive search, false otherwise.

regex.description: Set to true to use regular expressions for search texts.

pages.description: Comma-separated page numbers or ranges (e.g., "0,2,5-10"). Leave empty for all pages.

fileName.description: Desired name for the output PDF file (e.g., "result.pdf").

expiration.description: Set the expiration time for the output link in minutes (default is 60 i.e 60 minutes or 1 hour).

pdfPassword.description: Password if the source PDF is protected.

httpUsername.description: HTTP auth username if required to access source url.

httpPassword.description: HTTP auth password if required to access source url.

aiMetadata.description: Finds occurrences of given text in a source PDF (referenced by URL) and replaces them with new text, with optional case-sensitive matching or regular-expression patterns instead of literal search. Use when an agent needs to edit textual content in an existing document. Each call produces a new output PDF file and consumes credits, so it is not idempotent.
